featured_title: Can Your Buyer Actually Insure Your Home? Southwest Florida 2026
featured_excerpt: Florida law limits when a carrier can refuse a policy over roof age, and Citizens has hard eligibility walls at a $700,000 dwelling replacement cost and at $750,000 in the wind-borne debris region. The buyer's insurance quote lands in the 34 days between contract and closing, the one stretch of the timeline a seller cannot shorten by pricing better.
others_caption: Also this week: what Florida Amendment 3 means for Southwest Florida homeowners, Cascades at Estero after its builder went bankrupt, Grandezza vs Wildcat Run on which club sets your dues, Tidewater by Del Webb's occupancy rules, how to get a home removed from a Lee County flood zone, Naples school attendance zones, and what the guard at the gate costs at The Preserve at Corkscrew.
